title: lexsync: Lexical optimisation and hardware-timed experiment generation
description: A cross-platform (R and Python) toolkit that unifies many-language lexical-corpus access, parallel multidimensional stimulus matching, counterbalancing, item resampling, deterministic pseudoword generation and the automated generation of hardware-timed PsychoPy, OpenSesame and jsPsych experiment scripts for EEG/ERP and browser-based research. Distributed as a CRAN-ready R package and a PyPI-ready Python package that produce identical matched stimuli. The MIT licence covers the source code only; the bundled example lexica are wordfreq derivatives distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0, with the terms and the required attribution in LICENSE-DATA and corpora/ATTRIBUTION.md.
